---
title: "Grants"
---

```{r}
library(lubridate)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(readr)

source("R/data.R")
source("R/viz.R")
d <- seec_read_data()

updated <- with_tz(Sys.time(), "Africa/Johannesburg")

g <- seec_grants(d$grantlist)
grants <- g$grants
grants_long <- g$long
grants_yearly <- g$yearly
year_cols <- g$year_cols

latest_year <- max(grants_yearly$year)
latest <- grants_yearly %>% filter(year == latest_year)

holders <- grants_long %>%
  mutate(holder = strsplit(`Grant holder`, "\\s*/\\s*|\\s*,\\s*|\\s+and\\s+")) %>%
  tidyr::unnest(holder) %>%
  filter(!is.na(holder), holder != "")
```

::: last-updated
Last updated `r format(updated, "%d %B %Y, %H:%M %Z")` · Amounts in South African Rand
:::

```{r}
stat_row(
  stat_tile(paste("Funding in", latest_year), fmt_money(latest$total),
            paste(latest$active, "grants with funding that year")),
  stat_tile(paste0("Funding ", min(grants_yearly$year), "–", latest_year),
            fmt_money(sum(grants_yearly$total))),
  stat_tile("Average per year", fmt_money(mean(grants_yearly$total)),
            paste0(min(grants_yearly$year), "–", latest_year)),
  stat_tile("Grants since 2019", nrow(grants),
            paste(n_distinct(holders$holder), "grant holders"))
)
```

## Funding over time

::: chart-card
```{r}
seec_columns(
  grants_yearly, "year", "total",
  title = "Grant funding per year",
  subtitle = "Sum of yearly amounts across all grants",
  hover_fmt = function(v) paste0("R", fmt_num(v)),
  yprefix = "R", yformat = "~s"
)
```
:::

::: chart-card
```{r}
seec_columns(
  grants_yearly, "year", "active",
  title = "Grants with funding each year",
  subtitle = "Number of grants with a non-zero amount in that year",
  unit = " grants"
)
```
:::

```{r}
numbers_view(seec_numbers(
  grants_yearly %>%
    arrange(desc(year)) %>%
    transmute(Year = year, `Funding (R)` = total, Grants = active),
  columns = list(Year = colDef(format = colFormat(separators = FALSE)))
))
```

## Grant holders

```{r}
holder_totals <- holders %>%
  group_by(holder) %>%
  summarise(total = sum(amount), grants = n_distinct(Funder), .groups = "drop") %>%
  arrange(desc(total)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10) %>%
  mutate(hover = paste(grants, ifelse(grants == 1, "grant", "grants")))
```

::: chart-card
```{r}
seec_hbars(
  holder_totals, "holder", "total",
  title = "Top 10 grant holders by funding",
  subtitle = paste0(min(grants_yearly$year), "–", latest_year,
                    " · shared grants count in full for each holder"),
  label_fmt = fmt_money,
  hover_extra = "hover",
  xformat = "~s", xprefix = "R"
)
```
:::

## All grants

```{r}
grant_table <- grants %>%
  transmute(
    Project = Funder,
    `Grant holder`,
    Period = paste0(`Start Year`, "–", `End Year`),
    across(all_of(year_cols))
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(Period))

money_col <- function(col) colDef(
  align = "right", minWidth = 100,
  cell = function(v) if (is.na(v) || v == 0) "" else fmt_num(v),
  footer = function(values) fmt_num(sum(values, na.rm = TRUE))
)

seec_table(
  grant_table,
  id = "grants",
  columns = c(
    list(
      Project = colDef(minWidth = 200, footer = "Total"),
      `Grant holder` = colDef(minWidth = 200),
      Period = colDef(minWidth = 100)
    ),
    setNames(lapply(year_cols, money_col), year_cols)
  ),
  page_size = 25
)
```
